 VITALS : The  Indiana Pacers  (2-4) and  Brooklyn Nets (0-5) meet for the second of four matchups this regular season. On Oct. 25, the Pacers beat the Nets, 136-109. Last season, Indiana won the season series, 2-1. 
--> VITALS : The  Indiana Pacers  (2-4) and  Brooklyn Nets (0-5) meet for the second of four matchups this regular season. On Oct. 25, the Pacers beat the Nets, 136-109. Last season, Indiana won the season series, 2-1. 
 The Pacers are 117-85 all-time versus the Nets during the regular season, including 69-32 at home and 48-53 on the road.
--> The Pacers are 117-85 all-time versus the Nets during the regular season, including 69-32 at home and 48-53 on the road.
 The Pacers came into the 26-27 season set to build on their 2025 NBA Finals run with star point guard Tyrese Haliburton back in the fold. Additionally, the Pacers essentially replaced Myles Turner and Bennedict Mathurin from that Finals team with Ivica Zubac and Kelly Oubre Jr.
--> The Pacers came into the 26-27 season set to build on their 2025 NBA Finals run with star point guard Tyrese Haliburton back in the fold. Additionally, the Pacers essentially replaced Myles Turner and Bennedict Mathurin from that Finals team with Ivica Zubac and Kelly Oubre Jr.
 The Nets, meanwhile, drafted Mikel Brown Jr. with the sixth pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, as well as Joshua Jefferson with the 28th pick and Tyler Bilodeau with the 43rd pick.
--> The Nets, meanwhile, drafted Mikel Brown Jr. with the sixth pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, as well as Joshua Jefferson with the 28th pick and Tyler Bilodeau with the 43rd pick.
 As part of a four-team deal, the Nets traded Nicolas Claxton and the 33rd pick in the draft for Julius Randle and the 28th pick. 
--> As part of a four-team deal, the Nets traded Nicolas Claxton and the 33rd pick in the draft for Julius Randle and the 28th pick. 
 In free agency, they signed Keon Ellis and Moritz Wagner, while re-signing Day'Ron Sharpe and Josh Minott and also brought in Grant Nelson on a two-way deal.
--> In free agency, they signed Keon Ellis and Moritz Wagner, while re-signing Day'Ron Sharpe and Josh Minott and also brought in Grant Nelson on a two-way deal.
 The Pacers are coming off a,  145-125, loss to the Miami Heat on Friday night.
